verdict.rationale: The evidence shows CloudFormation templates and CDK code for defining and updating infrastructure, plus CLI command history. None of it documents versioning, review of changes before applying, or rolling back automations. Keeping templates in source control would be a user-side workaround, CLI history is a different feature, and deleting a stack is not a rollback, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
